executionProtocol: Use native Chrome/CUA as root owns; no hidden browser automation or source DOM injection required.
Capture build,URL,viewport,mode,scope chips,independent dates,local cut,role/access,and action/resultfor each assertion. Record theactual loadedbuild after each material fix.
Use settled DOM before dependent actions; a click attempt during a transition isnot a passed action.
Preservation journeys must not reset storage between origin/drill/Back/export. Reset only deliberately at NR01 or after archiving record evidence.
Log failures honestly, repair and replay affected checks. Keep original failures as historical and final repaired proof separate.

A visual surface capture does not prove controls not exercised; use appropriate existing model proof for calculation invariants rather than requiring manual inspection of all 3240leaves.
